snippet.title: Terrormolinos (C64 Longplay)
snippet.description:
1985 release by Melbourne House, retailing for £7.95.

An enjoyable graphic adventure, albeit with a limited parser. The vast majority of objects cannot be examined ("you can't" response).

Apart from the opening section where you have 60 moves to reach the airport, the game doesn't have time constraints, except when attacked/poisoned. All demises have been included.

Design:  Peter Jones and Trevor Lever
Coders:  James Bryne and Roger Taylor
Graphics:  Mike Robinson
